verses.text: Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó, ix yalan icha tik:

Al t'a heb' etisraelal, ha t'a lum slu'um heb' ol scha chi', hata' ol yak' jaye'ok chonhab' heb' t'a heb' levita b'aj ol kajnajok yet' pax lum kolan t'a spatik yichanh junjun chonhab' chi' b'aj ol wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' levita chi'.
Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ol kajnaj heb', haxo t'a spatik yichanh ol wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha lum kolan t'a spatik yichanh juntzanh schonhab' heb' ol ak'jok chi', ayokab' 450 metro tz'el t'a spatiktak.
Masanil jun lum chi', ay 900 metro t'a junjun pak'anh, lajannhej tz'aj sat t'a schanhil pak'anh. Haxo t'a snanhal yol sk'ol lu'um, hata' aykan junjun chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chonhab' tz'ak'ji t'a heb' levita chi', ayokab' wake'ok chonhab' b'aj syal b'at skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok anima. Ch'ok pax tzeyak' 42-okxo chonhab' t'a heb'.
Ha t'a masanil, yowalil tz'ak'ji 48 chonhab' t'a heb' levita chi' yet' slumal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Ha t'a lum smakb'en heb' yetisraelal heb' levita chi', hata' tz'elta juntzanh chonhab' tz'ak'ji t'a heb'. Yuj chi' junjun inhtilal syak' jaye'ok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ha juntzanh eyinhtilal niwak slu'um, tzijtum chonhab' syak' heb' t'a heb' levita chi', haxo juntzanh eyinhtilal kennhej slu'um, kennhej chonhab' syak' heb' t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, ol ex och chonhab'il t'a sat lum Canaán chi'.
Ol he sik'el jaye'ok chonhab' b'aj ol yal skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok anima tato manh sk'anok sk'o'ol sk'ulani.
Hata' skol sb'a jun chi', wach'chom sayji'ek' yuj junok mach ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', max yal-laj schami, tato maxto k'anb'aj t'ay yuj heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi'.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' b'aj skol sb'a heb' chi', wake' chonhab'il ol yil sb'a:
Oxe' skan t'a sk'axepalek'ta ha' Jordán tik, oxe' pax skan t'a Canaán chi'.

Ha t'a wake' chonhab' chi', hata' skol sb'a heb' anima smak'ancham junok anima, haton heb' eyetisraelal yet' heb' manh eyetchonhab'ok ayek' kajan t'a he kal, ma heb' tonhej tzek' posado. Hata' skol sb'a heb' tato manh sk'anok sk'ol heb' smak'ancham anima chi' heb'.

Tato ay junok mach smak'an junok anima yet' junok k'e'en yamk'ab' yik owal, ma yet' junok yaxk'e'en, ma yet' junok te te', talaj scham jun anima chi' yuj, a jun smak'waj chi', mak'umcham anima toni, yowalil smak'jipax chamok.
Ha junok ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh ix cham chi', ha' smak'anpaxcham winh ix mak'ancham jun anima chi' ayik schalan sb'a yet'ok.
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'ekanb'at pok'naj junok anima yujto schichonoch sk'ol t'ay, ma syekanb'at junok tas t'a yib'anh yuj yajk'olal,

mato smak'a' yujto yajk'ol sb'a heb', haxo tz'aji scham jun anima chi', yowalil smak'jipaxcham jun ix mak'waj chi', yujto mak'umcham anima. Yuj chi' a junok ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh ix cham chi', a smak'anpaxcham jun mach smilwaj chi'.
Palta k'inalok ay junok mach tz'ekan telwok junok anima, manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, tato malaj owal t'a skal heb', ma jun, syekanb'at junok tas t'a yib'anh,
hanhejtona' tato maj yilpaxi, sjulanb'at junok k'e'en haxo t'a junok anima sk'och k'e'en, scham yuj, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', manh yujok yak'an chukal t'ay yuj chi' icha chi' tz'aji.

Tato icha chi', sb'at skol sb'a jun anima chi' t'a junok chonhab' b'aj skol sb'a heb' anima chi'. Haxo heb' anima b'aj snib'ej skol sb'a chi', a heb' tz'ik'anb'at b'aj ix och jun chamel chi'. Haxo heb' anima kajan b'aj ix och chamel chi', a heb' sch'olb'itan jun ay smul chi' yet' jun ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', icha yalan sleyal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj ix b'at skol sb'a jun ix mak'ancham jun anima chi', a heb' skolan t'a yol sk'ab' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi'. Haxo heb' tz'ik'anxib'at t'a chonhab' b'aj ix xit'ek' skol sb'a chi'. Ha jun chi' skannhej ta' masanto scham winh sat sacerdote sik'b'iloch t'a jun pekti' chi'.
Palta tato tz'el t'a spatikel chonhab' b'aj ayek' skol sb'a chi',
tz'ilchajelta yuj jun mach ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun smak'nakcham chi', smak'jicham yuj jun tz'ilanelta chi', a jun smilwaj chi' max ochlaj smul.
Yuj chi' yowalil aynhejokab'ek' t'a yol chonhab' chi' masanto scham winh sat sacerdote, ichato chi' syal spax t'a schonhab'.
Ha juntzanh tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal, yalnhej b'ajtil ol ex kajnajok.
Tato ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo t'a spatik junok mach smak'ancham junok anima, a jun chi' ay sleyal schami. Tato junnhej testigo jun, max yal-laj schami.
Max yal-laj schaji k'e'en tumin tato toxo ix och t'a yib'anh junok mach to ix smak'cham junok anima, yowalil schami.
Max yal-laj schaji k'e'en tumin t'a junok smak'ancham junok anima yuj yel libre t'a chonhab' b'aj ayek' skol sb'a chi', yik spax t'a schonhab' ayik manto cham winh sat sacerdote.

Manh eyixtejb'at lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi' yuj schik'il anima smak'jichamok. Yuj chi' tato ay chik' tz'em t'a sat lu'um, malaj junok tas syal yak'an tupok, anhej to scham jun ix mak'ancham anima chi'.
Yuj chi', manh eyixtejb'at sat lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi', yujto a in Jehová in ayinek' t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik t'a sat lum lum chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
